jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue. Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.

We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.

About the role

Our Engineering team tackles the toughest challenges, so our users never have to. Real-time infrastructure, AI-native architecture, and a frontend that feels effortless - all powered by a team that moves fast, thinks rigorously, and holds an exceptionally high bar for quality.

We’re looking for a Product Engineer who cares deeply about building beautiful, performant systems — and wants to help reinvent how millions of people work.

What you'll do

  • Use your strong expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript to implement product features in our Node.js backend and React frontend.

  • Be part of the teams that deliver cutting-edge user experiences in a high-performance, data-rich application, driven by your expertise with modern frontend development techniques or distributed systems.

  • Learn and grow from some of the best technical talent working in the industry today.

  • Represent Attio’s Product & Engineering values both internally and externally.

What you'll bring

  • Expertise with JavaScript/TypeScript.

  • A track record of independent delivery, solving real customer or product problems as part of a team.

  • A proactive, self-motivated problem solving attitude, with a strong passion for learning new skills and experimenting with new techniques.

  • A good understanding of how excellent technical work can create great user experiences.

  • An ability to communicate technical ideas to the wider team and influence stakeholders across Engineering, Product and Design.

It’s a bonus if you:

  • Have experience of building backends with Node.js, or frontends with React or another similar framework.

  • Have experience contributing to, or participating in open source projects.

  • Have experience working with data-rich applications, or processing large volumes of real-time data.

  • Love experimenting with new ideas, tools and techniques, and exploring new technologies.

What we offer

  • Equity in an early-stage tech company on an incredible trajectory

  • Apple hardware

  • Team off-site in fun places! (We've been to Barcelona, Lisbon, Malta, and Split so far)

  • Location specific benefits

 

nb. We are open to candidates currently living in: Poland, Germany, Portugal, Ireland

Our Engineering team tackles the toughest challenges, so our users never have to. Real-time infrastructure, AI-native architecture, and a frontend that feels effortless - all powered by a team that moves fast, thinks rigorously, and holds an exceptionally high bar for quality.

We're looking for Platform Engineers who treat the platform as a product, with every engineer at Attio as its customer. You'll own the infrastructure, tooling and pipelines that let the rest of engineering ship quickly and safely, and you'll be accountable for keeping all of it reliable, fast and cost-effective as we scale.

What you'll do

  • Build and evolve our platform infrastructure as code (Terraform, Kubernetes, GCP), so every environment is reproducible, version-controlled and auditable.

  • Own our CI/CD pipelines end-to-end, making builds, tests and deploys fast, reliable and secure for every engineer at Attio.

  • Own our observability stack - metrics, logging and distributed tracing - as the foundation of an exceptional reliability culture.

  • Define and hold SLOs for latency, availability and error rates, and manage capacity to stay comfortably inside them.

  • Lead incident response: triage and resolve complex production issues, then run blameless post-mortems and ship the fixes as code.

  • Partner with product engineering teams to remove manual toil and shorten the path from writing code to running it in production.

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on experience operating production systems with an SRE mindset: SLOs, error budgets, toil reduction and blameless post-mortems.

  • Excellent knowledge of modern cloud architectures (either GCP or AWS), including networking, IAM and managed services.

  • Demonstrable deep expertise with Docker and Kubernetes at scale, covering cluster design, networking, storage and security.

  • Proficiency in a modern language such as Typescript, Go, Python or Rust, and a track record of writing well-tested automation.

  • Experience owning mission-critical operational tooling, including centralised logging or APM (e.g. Datadog, Splunk).

  • Ability to communicate technical ideas to the wider team and influence how other engineers build and operate their services.

  • Competitive salary of £105,000 to £125,000

  • Equity in an early-stage tech company on an incredible trajectory

  • Private medical insurance through AXA

  • Pension contribution through Hargreaves Lansdown

  • Enhanced family leave

Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.

We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.

About the role

Our Engineering team tackles the toughest challenges, so our users never have to. Real-time infrastructure, AI-native architecture, and a frontend that feels effortless - all powered by a team that moves fast, thinks rigorously, and holds an exceptionally high bar for quality.

We’re looking for Staff Product Engineers that can solve our hardest technical problems, both individually and through technical leadership. You’ll design and build software that creates delightful, groundbreaking user experiences. You’ll play a key role in growing the talent in our engineering organization through mentoring, coaching and hiring, and you’ll resolve our most tricky product issues through an understanding of what’s important to our users and business.

What you'll do

  • Provide technical leadership for a critical part of Attio’s engineering organization. You’ll work across teams to design significant parts of our infrastructure, aligning with Attio’s overall technical strategy. You’ll hold a high bar for the output of the teams you work with, ensuring that Attio executes both quickly and with quality.

  • Raise the bar on how we build and operate software. You’ll be part of a technical leadership group that sets standards for how we build and operate software at Attio, ensuring that we strive to build robust and maintainable systems that are reliable, scalable and secure.

  • Grow our engineering talent. You’ll mentor and coach the engineers you work with, and help ensure we hire the best talent for Attio. You’ll share your knowledge and growth mindset with the team, and be open to new approaches and experiments as software engineering evolves in the age of AI.

  • Deliver for the business. You’ll always look to optimize for Attio’s business, ensuring that we make the right trade-offs between delivery and perfection. You’ll strive to understand our customers and users so you can deliver the experiences which are uniquely valuable to them.

What you'll bring

  • First-class technical skills. First and foremost, you’ll be an excellent technical executor, with an ability to think in systems, not just crank out code. You’ll understand the world of distributed, cloud-native systems, and intuitively create the right interfaces to allow teams to innovate in parallel.

  • Proven technical leadership credentials. You’ll have a track record of not just personal execution, but of delivering projects through others. You’ll be able to break down large, complex problems into smaller, independent goals that others can own. You’ll understand how technical architecture impacts ability to deliver, and to maintain systems for the long term, and be sensitive to the need to pick the right compromise.

  • A growth mindset. Software engineering is changing rapidly in the age of AI, and you’ll understand the need to be open-minded and to experiment. You’ll be keen to teach, and to learn from the experience of others. You’ll relish the challenge of working in an area that’s new to you, and enjoy the discomfort that leads to personal growth.

  • A passion for growing the skills of others. As you deliver projects through your technical leadership, you’ll be keen to grow the next generation of technical leaders. You’ll have demonstrated impact through mentoring and coaching, and be able to flex your style depending on the needs of your colleagues. You’ll also be passionate about hiring the right talent for Attio.

  • A focus on the product and customer. You’ll have strong opinions on what makes a great product, and a keen desire to deliver the things which generate value for Attio’s customers. You’ll be curious to learn about how our product is used in the field, and have an understanding of how to use data to ensure we’re building the right thing.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary : £135K- 170K

  • Equity in an early-stage tech company on an incredible trajectory

  • 25 days holiday plus local public holidays

  • Apple hardware

  • [In the UK] Private medical insurance through AXA

  • [In the UK] Pension contribution through Hargreaves Lansdown

  • Enhanced family leave

  • Team off-site in fun places! (We've been to Barcelona, Lisbon, Malta, and Split so far)

Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue. Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.

The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.

About the role

Our Support team is at the heart of Attio’s customer experience — maintaining an exceptional 98% CSAT average over the past six months. We hold ourselves to an incredibly high standard at every stage of the customer journey, ensuring that every interaction reflects our commitment to clarity, care, and quality.

As a Technical Support Specialist, you’ll be the trusted voice of Attio to our customers — helping them solve problems, unlock value, and feel supported every step of the way. You’ll troubleshoot technical issues, share product best practices, and act as the customer’s advocate across teams.

This is a role for someone who thrives on problem-solving, loves getting into the details, and finds genuine satisfaction in turning a complex issue into a seamless experience. You’ll play a key role in maintaining the standards that make our customers love Attio — and help us set a new benchmark for excellence in B2B SaaS support.

This is Attio’s first hire in the APAC region, offering a unique opportunity to help establish our presence in Australia. As such, we’re looking for a self-starter who’s comfortable working autonomously, taking ownership, and navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.

What you'll do

In this role, you’ll take ownership of the technical and operational processes that keep our customers successful. You’ll combine empathy, product expertise, and clear communication to deliver best-in-class support.

Customer support excellence: Provide fast, high-quality support across email, chat, and video, maintaining strong CSAT and meeting SLAs across APAC hours.

Advanced technical troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve complex issues across Attio’s API (REST payloads, authentication, error handling), webhooks, SDKs, and integrations — identifying root causes rather than surface-level fixes.

Multi-system debugging: Investigate issues spanning Attio and third-party platforms, interpreting logs, error outputs, and system behaviours to triage effectively before escalating to Engineering.

Automation & workflow support: Advise on and troubleshoot customer-built automations (e.g. Zapier, Make, n8n), diagnosing failures and recommending improvements, while supporting equivalent builds within Attio’s native workflows.

AI & integrations support: Troubleshoot MCP server connections and support customers integrating Attio into AI-powered workflows and toolchains.

Autonomous regional ownership: Act as the primary technical support contact for APAC, independently managing a wide range of queries — from foundational product questions to complex technical investigations.

Customer advocacy: Surface recurring issues, patterns, and product feedback from the APAC region, acting as the voice of the customer to Support, Product, and Engineering.

Process and knowledge improvement: Contribute to Help Center content, internal documentation, and support workflows, continuously improving how we operate.

Product mastery: Build deep expertise in Attio’s product, APIs, and integrations, staying ahead of new features to support customers with confidence.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a customer-obsessed problem solver who combines technical curiosity with empathy and a love for helping others succeed.

Proven experience: 2+ years in a technical support or customer support role within SaaS, ideally in a startup or high-growth environment.

Strong technical depth: Experience troubleshooting APIs, integrations, and workflows; comfortable working with logs, debugging issues, and understanding system behaviour.

Automation experience: Familiarity with tools such as Zapier, Make, or n8n — either supporting customers or building automations directly.

AI & modern tooling curiosity: Experience with AI-powered workflows and emerging technologies.

Independent operator: Comfortable working autonomously, making decisions, and managing complex issues without constant oversight.

Excellent communication: Able to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely, both written and verbally.

Customer empathy: Strong instinct for understanding customer needs and delivering thoughtful, high-quality solutions.

Curiosity and initiative: Proactive, detail-oriented, and motivated to continuously learn and improve.

Collaborative mindset: Works effectively with Support, Product, and Engineering to deliver a seamless customer experience.

What we offer

  • Equity in an early-stage tech company on an incredible trajectory

  • 12% Superannuation contribution

  • 25 days holiday plus local public holidays

  • Apple hardware

  • Enhanced family leave

  • Team off-site in fun places! (We've been to Barcelona, Lisbon, Malta, and Split so far)

What does the hiring process look like?

Applicants can expect the following:

  • Initial Conversations

    • 30-minute introductory chat with a member of our Talent team

    • 30-minute track record interview with our Technical Support Specialist Manager

  • Core Interviews

    • Take-home technical exercise

    • 45-minute team panel interview to assess skills and collaboration style

    • 30-minute executive interview focused on impact and alignment with company goals

  • Final Stage

    • 30-minute closing conversation with our CEO

    • Offer call (if it’s a mutual fit)

jobs.title: Forward Deployed GTM Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Attio is the CRM for agentic revenue. Designed for the most ambitious go-to-market teams, it gives companies the power to understand every customer, automate at scale, and build their go-to-market motion exactly as they need. We've raised $116M from some of the world's best investors: GV (Google Ventures), Redpoint, Balderton, Point Nine, and 01A.

We hire builders who thrive on complex technical challenges, hold themselves to a high bar, and genuinely care about delighting the people who use what they build. The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.

About the role

Our Solutions team is integral to how we help customers adopt Attio quickly, integrate it deeply, and unlock lasting impact. As a Forward Deployed GTM Engineer, you'll work post-sale with customers on complex GTM use cases, embedding deeply in their systems to turn complex requirements into working solutions.

We're looking for an expert GTM Engineer who is opinionated, deeply customer-obsessed, and excited to architect and build alongside customers

 

What you'll do

  • Deploy post-sale into customers with complex GTM needs, architecting and building the systems, integrations, and workflows that help them get more from Attio

  • Design best-practice Attio configurations tailored to each customer's specific business model and GTM motion, from data architecture and integrations through to cross-team rollout

  • Lead and execute time-boxed build projects, delivering real working product: data models, integrations, sequences, workflows, and SDK apps

  • Build and architect custom API integrations and no-code automations (Zapier, n8n, Make, and equivalents) to connect Attio to the rest of a customer's stack

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers as the technical owner for complex post-sale deployments and build projects across shared accounts

  • Identify where customers are blocked, under-adopted, or leaving value on the table, and build solutions that help them get more from Attio

  • Bring customer insight back to our Product team, acting as a direct line between complex customer use cases and our roadmap

  • Design a range of engagement models, from Expert referrals to self-serve playbooks, that match support to customer need and continuously improve how Attio delivers world-class outcomes at scale

 

What you'll bring

  • 2+ years as a developer, GTM engineer, or in a technical solutions role

  • Deep hands-on experience with GTM tooling. You understand how Sales, CS, and Marketing teams operate and what actually matters to the people using these tools every day

  • Technical depth to independently architect, build, test, and deploy API integrations, working directly with customers to make technical decisions along the way

  • Hands-on experience building with AI coding platforms (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalents) to ship JavaScript and create reusable internal tooling

  • A genuine curiosity about the AI landscape and a habit of experimenting early. You're not waiting for the use case to be obvious before you start building

  • Strong command of the no-code/low-code integration stack, including n8n, Zapier, Make, or equivalents, and the ability to quickly form a credible opinion on an unfamiliar tool

  • Comfort with data infrastructure concepts including ETL, reverse ETL, CDPs, and tools like Segment, RudderStack, and Polytomic

 

What does the hiring process look like?

  1. 30-minute introductory phone call with a member of our Talent team

  2. 30-minute interview with our hiring manager

  3. Case study interview

  4. Panel interviews with relevant stakeholders

  5. 30-minute closing conversation with a member of our Executive Leadership Team

  6. Offer stage

We’re looking for Product Leads who are relentlessly curious, think in systems, thrive in technical complexity – and wants to help reinvent how millions of people work.

What you’ll do

  • Own core parts of the Attio product and contribute to overall product steering

  • Work with engineering to design systems that are simple to use but flexible and durable

  • Deeply understand the technical and user-facing implications of models, pipelines, and performance, making thoughtful decisions that balance speed, safety, and usability

  • Extend our AI capabilities, evaluating where AI meaningfully augments core workflows

  • Champion a culture of technical excellence and thoughtful simplicity, ensuring product foundations scale with our customers

  • Anticipate long-term architectural needs, guiding the roadmap for the next generation of Attio’s platform

  • Shape the metrics and signals we use to guide platform decisions

  • Ensure a best in class customer experience that delights users and builds on the Attio brand

What you’ll bring

  • Proven experience owning products, platforms, data models, or core infrastructure surfaces in a world class product.

  • You’ve shipped foundational systems.

  • A deep curiosity about how systems fit together. You enjoy diving into data models, untangling edge cases, and refining the foundations that critical systems rely on.

  • Strong technical depth and systems thinking. You’re comfortable reasoning about schemas, API design, and architectural trade-offs.

  • Comfort in navigating ambiguity. You can turn incomplete information into structured decisions and clear next steps.

  • Excellent product instincts. You know how to translate complex technical systems and customer problems into simple concepts and elegant user experiences.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. You can effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and articulate a clear vision.

  • Fluency in technical storytelling. You can can frame technical changes in ways that help GTM teams strengthen positioning and customer understanding.

  • Founder mentality. You take responsibility for outcomes end to end, and move strategical and tactical decisions forward.

Phone screen

  • Introductory call

  • Call with hiring manager

Interviews

  • Meet with Product, Design and Engineering

  • Live workshop ~2 hours - The live workshop focuses on a real Attio problem and mirrors how we collaborate day to day.

Offer stage

  • Competitive salary

  • Equity in an early-stage tech company on an incredible trajectory

  • 25 days holiday plus local public holidays

  • Apple hardware

  • Private medical insurance through AXA

  • Pension contribution through Hargreaves Lansdown

  • Enhanced family leave

  • Team off-site in fun places! (We've been to Barcelona, Lisbon, Malta and Split so far)

We're hiring a Senior/Lead Product Marketing Manager to join a small team with outsized impact.

Attio is defining the future of go-to-market. PMM delivers the message to the world. You'll shape how Attio shows up to our core audiences, from early-stage founders to the operators running today's category leaders. The work spans customer storytelling, product launches, and sales enablement, three levers that take a great product and turn it into a market-defining one.

You'll work directly with our founders, EPD, Sales, and Marketing. If you're looking for a builder role that owns meaningful outcomes for customers, we'd love to meet you.

 

What you'll do

  • Lead product launches end-to-end. Own positioning, messaging, and GTM strategy for new products and features. Ship launches that land with customers and move the business.

  • Develop product-focused content. Build the pages and posts on attio.com that bring our product story to life, and partner with Support to give customers the education they need to get the most out of Attio.

  • Bring customer stories to life. Create a steady library across the audiences that matter most, in whatever format the story deserves: case studies, video, web, social, or something we haven't tried yet.

  • Arm Revenue to win deals. Build the training, collateral, and enablement that helps Sales close new business and Success grow existing accounts.

  • Partner with EPD. Translate what we build into clear customer outcomes, and bring market signal back into how we build it.

  • Champion the customer. Be the in-house expert on who we sell to, why they buy, and what they need next.

  • Sharpen our competitive edge. Know the market cold: where Attio wins against legacy CRMs, where the new wave of challengers is going, and where the openings sit for our product and positioning.

 

What you’ll bring

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in product marketing.

  • You're a great writer. Whether it's positioning, web copy, a script, or a case study, you make every word count.

  • You have great taste. Even if you're not a designer by trade, you know what great looks like and can articulate a vision to produce beautiful work.

  • A bias for speed. You own projects from start to finish and move fast with teams to deliver high-quality results.

  • Builder mindset. You'll join a small but mighty team at Attio. You'll define playbooks, not inherit them.

  • Fluent in AI. We expect you to know how to use AI to work smarter and ship better.

You’ll stand out if you have:

  • Produced beautiful work across a variety of formats, especially video and web

  • Prior experience at a design-led company

What we offer

  • A competitive range of $145,000-$240,000 (leveling to be determined during interview process)

  • Equity in an early-stage tech company on an incredible trajectory

  • 25 days holiday plus local public holidays

  • Apple hardware

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sequoia One

  • 401K

  • Enhanced family leave

  • Team off-site in fun places! (We've been to Barcelona, Lisbon, Malta, and Split so far)

What does the hiring process look like?

Initial conversations

  • 30-minute intro with a member of our Talent team

  • 30-minute track record interview with our Head of Product Marketing

Core interviews

  • Case study session with our Head of Product Marketing and Product Marketing Manager

  • A set of working sessions exploring your approach to cross-functional relationships, marketing taste, and values alignment

Final stage

  • 30-minute closing conversation with a member of our leadership team

  • Offer call (if it’s a mutual fit)

Attio is an AI-native platform trusted with our customers' most sensitive data - and keeping that data secure is foundational to everything we build. As we scale, so does the challenge: a large multi-tenant SaaS platform, AI-driven product features that introduce entirely new attack surfaces, and an engineering team shipping fast with AI-assisted development.

We're looking for a Security Engineering Lead to build and lead Attio's Product Security function, spanning application security and security operations. You'll work alongside our Engineering Leadership to make Attio secure by design, lead the response when things go wrong, and recruit a world-class team of Security Engineers and SecOps practitioners. This is a rare opportunity to define how security works at a company operating at the frontier of AI.

What you’ll do

  • Build and lead Attio’s Product Security function. Secure Attio’s large-scale, AI-native SaaS platform, and the sensitive customer data on which it operates.

  • Work with Engineering Leadership peers to ensure that Attio is secure by design.

  • Understand and mitigate the unique risks and attack vectors associated with AI-driven product features, and AI-assisted software development.

  • Ensure that Attio is at the forefront of secure software development and operational practices.

  • Lead production security incident response; deeply understand security issues and their associated root causes and risks, create remediation plans, and drive to resolution.

  • Recruit and retain a world-class team of Security Engineers and SecOps practitioners.

What you’ll bring

  • Full understanding of the Application Security landscape in a high scale, multi-tenant SaaS context.

  • Appreciation of the tools and techniques used to secure SaaS applications, through prevention, detection and remediation of security issues. Understanding of how to integrate those tools into an effective, scalable, cost-efficient program that delivers a secure service.

  • First-class incident response skills, through the entire incident lifecycle of detection, remediation, clean-up, and post-incident corrective action.

  • A recognized “talent magnet” and mentor who can recruit, retain and develop a high-quality Information Security team which continues to deliver for the business as Attio scales.

Desirable

  • Experience of running an Application Security program in a high scale, multi-tenant SaaS context.

  • Experience of hiring and managing a team of Security Engineers, and working with cross-functional partners.

  • Raise the bar on how we build and operate software. You’ll be part of a technical leadership group that sets standards for how we build and operate software at Attio, ensuring that we strive to build robust and maintainable systems that are reliable, scalable and secure.

  • Grow our engineering talent. You’ll mentor and coach the engineers you work with, and help ensure we hire the best talent for Attio. You’ll share your knowledge and growth mindset with the team, and be open to new approaches and experiments as software engineering evolves in the age of AI.

  • Deliver for the business. You’ll always look to optimize for Attio’s business, ensuring that we make the right trade-offs between delivery and perfection. You’ll strive to understand our customers and users so you can deliver the experiences which are uniquely valuable to them.

What you'll bring

  • First-class technical skills. First and foremost, you’ll be an excellent technical executor, with an ability to think in systems, not just crank out code.   • Proven technical leadership credentials. You’ll have a track record of not just personal execution, but of delivering projects through others. You’ll be able to break down large, complex problems into smaller, independent goals that others can own. You’ll also be passionate about hiring the right talent for Attio.

You’ll be curious to learn about how our product is used in the field, and have an understanding of how to use data to ensure we’re building the right thing.

The team here brings sharp judgement, real craft, and the drive to do exceptional work. We're obsessed about the details and energized by the frontier.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.

Why this role matters

We're doubling the size of Engineering, Product, and Design year-on-year, and the biggest constraint on how fast we build is how fast we hire. You'll join the Talent team as the connective tissue between EPD leadership and the best engineers in Europe; one day you’ll be running a sharp headhunting process process for a Staff Engineer and the next pushing a high-volume inbound pipeline through with the same rigor. Both are equally important.

Attio is for people who own their role, learn quickly, are endlessly curious, and find happiness in delivering consistently brilliant outcomes that push the company forward. We love working with people who are passionate about working this way and will do whatever it takes to get things done.

We're particularly keen to hear from people with:

  • A track record of recruiting engineers into a startup or scale-up with a genuinely high bar agency-side or in-house

  • Experience hiring software engineers who'd pass a tough technical bar, not just filling a requisition

  • Range across both ends of the funnel: targeted, hand-crafted outbound and high-volume inbound processing, without letting either slip

  • A hands-on AI-first approach to sourcing and screeningusing modern tooling to work faster, not just talking about it

  • Time spent inside a high-growth environment where the team doubled year after year, and the process had to hold up under that pressure

Whether you've cut your teeth at a high-bar engineering recruitment agency, grown up inside a fast-scaling startup, or learned rigor at a big tech company, what matters more than your last logo is that you've done the reps and you're ready to do a lot more of them here.

What you'll be doing

  • Own high-volume inbound processing without letting quality or candidate experience slip

  • Build and run sourcing strategies for some of the hardest engineering roles in Europe

  • Work on recruiting events, recruitment events and foster interest in Attio through your talent network and community

  • Run processes end-to-end, from screening to offer management and admin to reporting

The attributes we're looking for

  • Resilient our bar is high. We only hire around 0.2% of the candidates that we source or review. You need to be genuinely fine with that ratio, not just tolerate it.

  • Resourceful the best people exist; our job is finding and reaching them, however unconventional the route.

  • Committed hiring managers need to trust that you're fully focused on raising the bar for the team, day in and day out.

  • Thoughtful given our trajectory, a role at Attio will be a genuinely meaningful step for the right person, but you can't assume that it's right for everyone — we understand what candidates actually want before we tell them why we're a fit.

  • Hustle we're competing with the best, for the best. Your instincts, speed and innovative approach are often the difference between winning a candidate and losing them to someone else.

What does the hiring process look like?

We respond to candidates within 48 hours of every interview.

  1. Application review

  2. Hiring Manager interview - 30 minutes

  3. Case study / panel interview (two parts) - 1.5 hours

  4. Stakeholder interview with our VP of Engineering - 30 minutes

  5. Executive round with our CEO - 30 minutes

Most interviews are self-scheduled, but we're always on hand if you have questions along the way. By the offer stage, you may want to meet more of the team, see a demo, or ask us anything else.

What will an offer consist of?

  • A competitive salary

  • Equity in an early-stage company on an exceptional trajectory

  • Apple hardware and a budget for desk amenities

  • 25 days holiday plus local public holidays

  • Regular team events in London

  • Team off-sites in fun places (Barcelona, Lisbon, Malta, and Split so far)

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Strong commercial instincts and an ability to recognize customer potential beyond current spend or company size.

  • Experience working at an early- or growth-stage startup.

  • A proactive mindset and comfort operating with autonomy in a fast-moving environment.

  1. Talent Introduction

  2. Hiring Manager Interview

  3. Solutioning Exercise

  4. Meet the Team: Three focused conversations with key stakeholders

  5. Executive Leadership Conversation

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.

About the role

We want every great startup to be using Attio. This role exists to make that happen.

We're looking for someone who has lived the startup journey, knows the ecosystem inside out, and has the relationships and instincts to move fast at the highest level. You'll own Attio's position in the Bay Area entirely - from the programs and partnerships that drive adoption, to the events and content that shape how founders think about Attio, to removing whatever friction stands between a great startup becoming a customer.

You'll operate with founder-level scope and autonomy - working across product, sales, and marketing to remove blockers and do whatever it takes to make Attio the default CRM for the best startups in the world.

The ideal candidate is deeply networked in SF and the broader tech ecosystem, has the pattern recognition of a former founder, VC, or early operator at a generational company, and is senior enough to drive forward and make things happen.

Important Note: We’re approaching this search with some flexibility on title, level, and compensation — our priority is finding the right person, and we’ll shape the role accordingly.

What you'll do

  • Startup dominance - Own the goal of getting every top startup onto Attio, with a relentless focus on YC and top accelerator cohorts, Series A penetration, and logos across the best VC portfolios

  • Strategic partnerships - Build deep relationships with the most influential VCs, accelerators, and ecosystem players - not as a channel, but as a genuine partner in how they support their portfolios

  • Events + community - Conceive and execute high-impact events - demo days, summits, dinners, hackathons - that bring the best founders together and position Attio at the centre of that world

  • Founder relationships - Be personally known and trusted by the founders of the next generation of breakout companies; be their go-to for advice, introductions, and tools

  • Cross-functional execution - Work across product, sales, and marketing to remove friction, identify gaps, and ship whatever is needed - new motions, integrations, custom work - to serve the startup market

  • Content + storytelling - Shape the narrative that makes Attio the obvious CRM choice for founders, producing content that resonates deeply with how they actually build

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of experience as a founder, VC, or early operator at a high-growth startup - you've been in the room when the important decisions get made

  • A genuine, existing network across the startup ecosystem - you know the founders, the investors, and the connectors

  • The instincts and credibility to earn trust with early-stage founders quickly, and the seniority to drive decisions internally at pace

  • A track record of building and shipping complex programs or initiatives that moved the needle

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling narratives for the founder audience

  • A builder's mindset - you're comfortable with ambiguity, operate with urgency, and take full ownership of outcomes

  • An eye for quality - whether it's a startup program, a founder dinner, or a piece of content, you know what great looks like and hold yourself to it

What does the hiring process look like?

  • Initial conversations

    • 30-minute intro with a member of our Talent team

    • 30-minute track record interview with our Chief of Staff

  • Core interviews

    • The interview process will include three working sessions exploring your approach to problem solving and execution, ecosystem and activation thinking, and your perspective on AI, founder authenticity, and values alignment.

  • Final stage

    • 30-minute closing conversation with a member of our leadership team

    • Offer call (if it’s a mutual fit)

Sales Development Representatives generate top of funnel pipeline at Attio, running outbound campaigns and progressing prospects who've dropped out of the funnel, working closely with our Account Executive team to move qualified opportunities forward. This role is foundational to pipeline generation and one of the clearest paths into broader GTM roles at Attio over time.

 

What You'll Do

  • Run targeted, multi-channel outbound campaigns to generate net-new opportunities

  • Progress prospects who dropped out of the funnel, turning stalled interest back into pipeline

  • Coordinate with AEs to schedule meetings, share calendar context, and communicate early stage discovery

  • Work cross functionally with Marketing and RevOps to improve targeting and process over time

  • Own your outreach and prospect experience from first touch through AE handoff

  • Partner with sales leadership to develop efficient lead funnel processes using Attio

What We're Looking For

  • We are particularly interested in hearing from candidates with:

    • A track record of owning outcomes and following through on commitments

    • A habit of grounding decisions in evidence and reasoning, particularly when prioritizing across competing demands

    • A genuine track record of seeking out feedback and acting on it

    • Communication that adapts to different audiences

What the Hiring Process Looks Like

  • Talent Introduction (~30 minutes)

  • Hiring Manager Interview (~30 minutes)

  • Take-Home Exercise

  • Take-Home Review with your Hiring Manager

  • Meet the Team: Two focused conversations with key stakeholders

  • Executive Leadership Conversation

  • Offer
